QuestInfo.name: To Henesys, the Prairie Town
QuestInfo.0: Mentally exhausted from endless adventuring, a peaceful rest sounds pretty good right now.
QuestInfo.1: It seems #m10001000# offers various services for adventurers. I should drop by #m10001000# if I'm ever in the area.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: #p229#, the Town Clerk I met at #m10001007#, suggested I become a resident of #m10001000#. Once I've made up my mind, I should speak with #p229# for more details.

0.0: Adventuring is great, but sometimes I just want to take a break. Since it's on my mind, maybe I'll swing by #b#m10001007##k?

yes.0: If I want to learn more about #m10001000#, going to the Town Hall seems like the best bet. I should drop by when I have some time.

no.0: No, I'd rather focus on adventuring for now.

1.0: Welcome to #m10001000#! Adventurers are always more than welcome here. Now that you're here, would you mind if I made a special proposal?
1.1: A long time ago, wandering archers gathered one by one to found #m10001000#. Today, #p202# and the archer instructor #p221# serve as our dependable pillars.
1.2: Vast prairies, warm weather, and friendly neighbors... I honestly think #m10001000# is the absolute definition of a wonderful place to live.
1.3: That's why #m10001000# recently decided to #boffer adventurers the chance to become official residents#k, so more people can settle down here! Wonderful, isn't it?
1.4: If you ever become interested in obtaining #b#m10001000# Citizenship#k, please feel free to speak with me anytime!

level.0: Could you please speak to me again after you reach Level 12 or higher?
